thread:
ops_ray: Heads up — after yesterday's VPC egress tighten we started seeing GPU warmups failing in us-west-2, warmup success rate down to ~40%.

alex_infra: saw it, charts spike at 02:12 UTC in gpu_warmup_success_rate and a bunch of kube node join errors.

sre_jordan: getting KMS handshake timeouts in the node logs: 'kms: decrypt timeout=10s' repeated while the node tries to fetch boot secrets.

ops_ray: correlated that with the ephemeral KMS rotation we kicked off for audit-shipper service yesterday evening — rotation hit many regions at once.

security_liz: that rotation was staged to meet compliance window for audit retention. we didn't anticipate it coinciding with the VPC egress narrowing.

alex_infra: root cause looks like a traffic-path change: audit shippers now prefer privatelink endpoints that live behind a separate NAT fleet with small conntrack pools — bursts are dropping handshakes.

ops_ray: immediate mitigation proposal: temporary allowlist the audit shippers' privatelink CIDRs in the tightened egress policy so KMS handshakes don't get reset mid-flight. @security_liz can you sign off for 30m window?

security_liz: ok for short window, but we need an explicit TTL and audit entry. propose 30m and add a note to the rotation ticket.

product_maya: FYI this degrades Dedicated customers' cold-starts. observed customer-facing cold-starts >2m in some logs — flagging for support.

sre_jordan: quick workaround I'm pushing to staging: increase local warmup parallelism so nodes don't wait for remote KMS handshakes. script: 
```
kubectl patch ds gpu-warmup -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"infra/warmup-override":"true"}}}}}'
```
This forces warmup pods to spin multiple attempts in parallel.

deploybot: canary to eu-west-1 started (40 nodes) with the patch. monitoring for failures.

alex_infra: medium-term fixes: 1) scale up NAT conntrack on the privatelink fleet, 2) split audit-shipper traffic across two privatelink endpoints, 3) stagger KMS rotations by region.

security_liz: agree on staggering rotations — avoids fleet-wide handshake storms. will update rotation playbook.

ops_ray: cost impact note: scaling NATs and conntrack capacity is estimated ~+$4.2k/mo. tagging this for infra budget queue.

product_maya: please add to next sprint backlog and notify sales/support so they can preempt customers.

sre_jordan: monitoring TODOs: add alert if gpu_warmup_success_rate < 0.8 for 5m, add KMS_decrypt_latency p90 > 1s. also surface new metric: audit_shipper_privatelink_retries.

ops_ray: logging change: add tag 'audit_shipper_path=privatelink' to shipper logs to trace after reconfiguration.

security_liz: temporary allowlist approved for 30m (CIDRs posted in incident ticket). I'll follow up with rotation staggering plan.

ops_ray: thanks — I'll roll the patch to prod after canary is green and then create an item in #incidents with the postmortem checklist. :thumbsup:
